description: Assumed NTEC liquid-metal shear-layer screening conditions; not measurements.

feed.source: pure methane feed; representative operating point (assumed, uncalibrated); see moose/operating_points/README.md

parameter_sources.geometry.reactor_volume_m3: 100 cm^3 Couette/Taylor liquid-metal shear cell volume; see moose/operating_points/README.md
parameter_sources.geometry.interface_area_m2: 0.1 m^2 dispersed gas-liquid-dielectric interfacial area; see moose/operating_points/README.md
parameter_sources.operating.pressure_Pa: 1 atm standard ambient pressure (101325 Pa); see moose/operating_points/README.md
parameter_sources.operating.methane_mass_flow_kg_s: representative laboratory CH4 feed flow (1e-7 kg/s); see moose/operating_points/README.md
parameter_sources.operating.shear_rate_s_inv: 200 s^-1 Couette shear rate benchmark; see moose/operating_points/README.md
parameter_sources.operating.mechanical_power_W_kg: 20 W/kg specific agitation power; see moose/operating_points/README.md
parameter_sources.properties.liquid_viscosity_Pa_s: Assael et al., J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 41 (2012) 033101 (~2 mPa s for liquid GaInSn/Bi alloys)
parameter_sources.properties.permittivity_F_m: SiO2/Al2O3 contact-dielectric layer permittivity (~8 epsilon_0 = 7e-11 F/m); see moose/operating_points/README.md
parameter_sources.properties.ionic_conductivity_S_m: trace interfacial ionic leakage conductivity (1.0 S/m); see moose/operating_points/README.md
